title: Japanese-Style Jamaican Jerk Stew
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with the bold spices of Jamaican jerk seasoning, served over a bed of fluffy rice.
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
3. Add the stew and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
4. Stir in the Jamaican jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the ozzy and rice to the pan, and stir to combine.
6. Cook for 5 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
7. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil to the pan, and stir to combine.
8. Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
9. Serve the stew over the rice, garnished with chopped green onions.
